attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of immense physical mass, deep chest depth, and the characteristic pattern of a rich fawn/red coat contrasted with clean white markings on the blaze and ventral areas.

attributes.head_and_ears: Long, refined skull structure; narrow muzzle tapering gracefully; ears are medium-sized, set high on the head, and carried close to the skull.
attributes.eyes: Large, almond-shaped eyes with a keen expression; typically dark amber or brown.
attributes.coat: Extremely fine, short, and silky coat texture; color ranges from pale fawn to rich reddish-tan or sandy hues.
attributes.body: Long, exceptionally lean and graceful body; deep chest supported by a finely chiseled frame; narrow waistline leading to powerful hindquarters; tail is medium length and carried with elegance.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of extreme linearity, delicate bone structure, and the luxurious, short silky coat that conveys a profile of effortless elegance.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately long, strong muzzle; skull is well-defined. Ears are medium in length, erect, and set high on the head.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown to black; almond-shaped, conveying alertness and intelligence.
attributes.coat: Extremely dense double coat. The undercoat is thick, providing insulation, while the outer guard hairs are soft and lie smoothly. Coloration is typically pure white or creamy white.
attributes.body: Medium to large, sturdy, and well-boned. The body is balanced with moderate angulation. Tail is thick at the base, carried high over the back, and plume-like.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The characteristic 'Sammy smile' formed by the upturned corners of the mouth, combined with the pristine, voluminous white double coat.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately sized skull proportionate to body; muzzle is defined but not overly long. Ears are erect, triangular, and set high on the head.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown to black; alert, intelligent expression with a moderate orbital prominence.
attributes.coat: Short, smooth, and dense double coat. Colors range widely but often include fawn, red, or sable tones with minimal harsh markings.
attributes.body: Compact, sturdy, and agile build. The body is well-muscled with a moderate depth of chest. Tail is typically carried naturally and moderately sized.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: A balanced combination of small stature, robust bone structure, and a highly alert facial expression.

attributes.head_and_ears: Strong, well-defined skull; moderate muzzle length; ears are small and typically semi-erect or drop slightly.
attributes.eyes: Deep, dark brown; expressive and alert.
attributes.coat: Dense, harsh double coat; texture is wiry and coarse; colors range from various shades of tan to grizzle or wheaten.
attributes.body: Compact, sturdy, and muscular build; low to the ground stance; tail is typically carried level or slightly down.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the low, powerful body structure and the uniform harshness of the wiry coat.

attributes.head_and_ears: Long, noble head with a moderate stop; muzzle is strong and tapering. Ears are long, pendulous, and set high on the skull.
attributes.eyes: Deep-set, almond shape; typically dark brown or amber, conveying intelligence and nobility.
attributes.coat: A dense, harsh double coat. The outer coat is long and ranges from grizzled gray to tan or fawn, often with variable tipping. Undercoat provides insulation.
attributes.body: Elegant and powerful frame; long, gracefully sloping body line. The tail is long, tapering, and carried low, often heavily feathered.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of extreme length and graceful proportions, supported by a strong bone structure, combined with the characteristic long, flowing coat.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately sized skull, strong and defined muzzle; ears are prick, medium in length, and carried erect.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown, almond-shaped, conveying alertness and intelligence.
attributes.coat: Harsh, dense double coat; texture is wiry and resilient. Colors range from solid black to grizzled tan or mixture patterns.
attributes.body: Compact, sturdy, and well-boned build; moderate length with a strong loin. Tail is typically medium in length, carried level or slightly down.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the low-slung, powerful frame and the uniform harshness of the wiry double coat.

attributes.head_and_ears: Refined skull structure, moderate muzzle length proportionate to head; ears are medium-sized, set high, and carried semi-erectly.
attributes.eyes: Deep, dark brown hue; almond shape contributing to an intelligent expression.
attributes.coat: Dense double coat of medium length, offering a soft texture; colors range from sable to tricolor patterns.
attributes.body: Elegant, balanced physique with moderate bone structure; tail is tapering and carried moderately.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The clean lines of the coat combined with the refined proportions, giving a graceful and compact appearance.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately sized skull, short muzzle, often topped with a voluminous mane or topknot; ears are medium-sized and carried close to the head.
attributes.eyes: Large, dark brown, expressive, and almond-shaped.
attributes.coat: Long, dense double coat; texture is silky and flowing. Colors are varied but often include rich tones (e.g., gold, black, brindle) and may feature distinct patterns.
attributes.body: Compact, sturdy, and well-muscled body structure. The tail is typically carried moderately and covered by the long coat.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of a compact, balanced body with an exceptionally luxurious and flowing coat that frames the face and head.

attributes.head_and_ears: Strong, wedge-shaped skull; muzzle is proportionate to the head and moderately tapering. Ears are erect, triangular, and set high on the skull.
attributes.eyes: Medium-sized, almond shape; often striking blue or multi-colored (heterochromia is common).
attributes.coat: Dense, double coat of medium length. Colors vary but often include sable gray, black, or red base tones with distinct markings (agouti pattern).
attributes.body: Medium to large, muscular, and well-boned. The body is proportionate to the head, with a moderate taper toward the rear. Tail is medium length and carried naturally.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the erect, proportionate ears and the thick, insulating double coat structure.

attributes.head_and_ears: Refined skull structure; muzzle is proportionate and tapering. Ears are set high on the head, carried close to the skull, often semi-erect or laid back.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown to black; almond shape, conveying alertness and intelligence.
attributes.coat: Extremely fine, silky texture; medium length. The body coat exhibits a characteristic slate-gray or steel-blue hue, complemented by tan markings on the legs, chest, and face.
attributes.body: Elegant, balanced build; medium frame. The body is proportionate to the head, with a graceful carriage. Tail is typically carried naturally and gracefully.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the fine, flowing silky coat texture and the specific slate-gray body coloration contrasted with tan points.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately long skull, tapering muzzle of medium length; ears are set high and carried semi-erect, often folding slightly at the tips.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown to amber hue; almond-shaped, conveying alertness and intelligence.
attributes.coat: Close, smooth, soft double coat; color ranges from rich golden yellow to deep wheaten, often with slight variations in tone across the body. The coat is uniform and sleek.
attributes.body: Medium-sized, sturdy yet graceful build; strong bone structure. The tail is typically carried level with the back and is medium in length, tapering gracefully.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the uniform, smooth wheaten coat texture and the balanced, athletic frame characteristic of a versatile terrier.

attributes.head_and_ears: Massive, broad skull; deep stop; powerful muzzle that is proportionate to the head; ears are medium-sized, set high, and carried close to the head.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown, deep-set, conveying intelligence and steadfastness.
attributes.coat: Short, dense, smooth double coat; texture is tight and close to the body. Colors range from fawn, red, brindle, or pied.
attributes.body: Muscular, powerful, and compact build; deep chest; strong bone structure. Tail is medium length, set low, and carried level with the back.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: Extremely powerful neck musculature and a robust, low-slung gait that conveys immense physical presence.

attributes.head_and_ears: Proportionate skull, tapering muzzle of medium length; ears are pendulous and set high on the head.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown, almond-shaped, conveying intelligence and alertness.
attributes.coat: Dense, resilient double coat texture; highly pliable and capable of being groomed into tight curls or straight lines depending on the desired finish. Colors range widely but structure remains consistent.
attributes.body: Withered, elegant frame with strong bone structure; musculature is balanced and graceful. Tail is carried level or slightly curved.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique ability of the coat to maintain its volume and structure, allowing for highly stylized grooming while retaining a dense undercoat.

attributes.head_and_ears: Strong, blocky skull with a well-defined stop; muzzle is proportionate and firm. Ears are typically pendulous or semi-erect, set high on the skull.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown, almond-shaped, conveying intelligence and alertness.
attributes.coat: Dense, harsh double coat. The texture is coarse and weather-resistant. Coloration is typically salt-and-pepper gray or silver, often with black tipping.
attributes.body: Compact, sturdy, and well-muscled build. The body is balanced with moderate bone structure. Tail is thick at the base and carried low.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The characteristic salt-and-pepper gray coat combined with the powerful, squared facial structure and dense muzzle.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderate skull structure, well-defined muzzle of medium length, ears are set moderately high and hang pendulously.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown, expressive, almond-shaped, conveying alertness and warmth.
attributes.coat: Medium length, soft texture with a dense undercoat; colors range from rich mahogany and deep red to black tipping, often exhibiting tan points or tricolor patterns.
attributes.body: Medium frame, sturdy yet graceful build, with a balanced proportion between bone structure and muscle mass. The tail is typically carried moderately and feathered.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the refined head carriage, medium-boned structure, and the rich, variable coloration achieved through the coat's layering.

attributes.head_and_ears: Massive, broad skull; powerful neck musculature; muzzle is strong and proportionate to head, neither excessively long nor short; ears are medium-sized, set high on the skull, and carried erect.
attributes.eyes: Deeply set; typically amber or dark brown; expression is noble and watchful.
attributes.coat: Extremely dense, thick double coat providing insulation; texture is coarse and harsh to the touch; colors range from pure white, cream, gold, fawn, or sable, often with variable shading and ticking.
attributes.body: Massive, heavily muscled, and powerful build; body is substantial and squarely proportioned; tail is long, thick at the base, and carried low or moderately high when relaxed, often heavily plumed.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The sheer density and volume of the double coat, combined with the immense bone structure and powerful head carriage, giving an imposing presence characteristic of a guardian breed.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately sized skull, well-defined muzzle of medium length, tapering gently. Ears are prick, set high on the skull, and carried erect or semi-erect.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown to amber hue, almond shape, conveying alertness and intelligence.
attributes.coat: Dense double coat providing insulation. Texture is variable but typically harsh or wiry to soft, depending on the specific color/line. Colors range from grizzle and tan to solid black or red, often with variable ticking or tipping.
attributes.body: Sturdy, compact, and muscular build. The body is proportionate to the head, with moderate bone structure. Tail is typically medium length and carried moderately.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: A robust, balanced physique combined with a dense, weather-resistant double coat and an alert expression maintained by the erect ear carriage.

attributes.head_and_ears: Proportional skull structure, moderate stop, tapering muzzle, and ears carried close to the head in a pendulous manner.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown, almond-shaped, conveying intelligence and alertness.
attributes.coat: Dense, tightly curled double coat texture; maintained in various lengths depending on grooming style (e.g., clipped or full), allowing for defined body contours.
attributes.body: Small, elegant frame with a balanced, well-muscled build; tail is carried proportionate to the body and often docked or naturally tapering.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The highly resilient, ringleted coat texture and the graceful carriage that maintains a refined silhouette.

attributes.head_and_ears: Small, refined skull proportionate to body; muzzle is short and well-defined. Ears are typically small, set high, and carried semi-erect or alert.
attributes.eyes: Bright, expressive dark eyes that convey alertness and intelligence.
attributes.coat: Dense, harsh double coat with a wiry texture. Color patterns are varied but commonly include grizzled blacks, rich browns, and tan markings.
attributes.body: Compact, agile frame with a sturdy yet delicate bone structure. The body is balanced and proportionate to the head.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of small, spirited stature and the characteristic harsh, dense double coat texture.

attributes.head_and_ears: Long, lean skull structure; moderate muzzle length that is neither too short nor too long; ears are set moderately high and carried close to the head.
attributes.eyes: Deep, dark amber or brown; almond-shaped and highly expressive.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, smooth, dense double coat; uniform coloration ranging from rich golden-russet to deep mahogany.
attributes.body: Elegant, medium-to-large frame; muscular yet linear build; strong bone structure; tail is of moderate length and carried level with the back.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The characteristic uniform, solid russet coat color and the dog's graceful, athletic gait.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately long skull structure with a tapering muzzle; ears are pendulous, set high on the skull, and reach to the ground when relaxed.
attributes.eyes: Deep amber or dark brown; almond-shaped, conveying a focused, earnest expression.
attributes.coat: Medium length, dense double coat. Coloration is typically sable or liver-tan with distinct black tipping on the saddle and muzzle blaze.
attributes.body: Athletic, medium-boned frame with moderate depth of chest. Tail is carried moderately long and tapering, maintaining balance during movement.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: A pronounced muscularity in the neck and shoulders, coupled with a specific white blaze extending from the stop to the muzzle.

attributes.head_and_ears: Long, well-chiseled skull; strong neck attachment; medium-length muzzle that is neither too short nor too long; ears are typically dropped or semi-erect, set well on the head.
attributes.eyes: Medium in size, almond-shaped; dark brown or amber hue, conveying intelligence and expressiveness.
attributes.coat: Short, dense, extremely smooth, and highly lustrous. The coat is solid in color, typically ranging from deep black to rich liver-gray (grullo).
attributes.body: Elegant, muscular, and well-balanced frame. The body is proportionate to the head, with strong bone structure and a medium length. Tail is carried level or slightly downward.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The uniform, solid coloration (black or liver) combined with the sleek, highly polished texture of the short coat and the noble carriage.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderate skull, well-defined stop, proportionate muzzle; ears are set high and carried pendulous, reaching the ground when relaxed.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown, large, and highly expressive, set appropriately for the skull structure.
attributes.coat: Medium-long, dense double coat; texture is soft and slightly wavy. Coloration varies but typically includes rich ranges of liver, black, or various shades of brown/red.
attributes.body: Medium-boned, well-balanced structure with moderate depth of chest. The body is sturdy but graceful, tapering slightly toward the hindquarters. Tail is carried level with the back and feathered.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of a strong, yet elegant frame with the characteristic pendulous ears and rich, variable coat colors.

attributes.head_and_ears: Small, well-chiseled skull; strong but proportionate muzzle; ears are small, erect, and set high on the head.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown to black; bright, alert, and expressive.
attributes.coat: Dense, harsh double coat; uniform pure white coloration with no ticking or markings; texture is smooth yet sturdy.
attributes.body: Compact, squarely built body with strong bone structure; legs are straight and sturdy; tail is set low and carried up when alert.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the pure white coat and the dense, harsh texture provides a highly uniform visual profile.

attributes.head_and_ears: Long, refined skull structure; moderate muzzle length tapering gently; ears set high and carried close to the head, often semi-erect or folded.
attributes.eyes: Large, expressive, almond-shaped; typically dark brown or amber hue.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, fine, smooth coat texture; colors range from fawn to brindle, often with variable shading.
attributes.body: Elegant, muscular yet graceful physique; deep chest supported by a relatively narrow waist; tucked abdomen characteristic of sighthound conformation; medium-length tail carried gracefully.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the refined, elongated head profile and the sleek, powerful musculature necessary for high-speed locomotion.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately long skull, defined stop, strong muzzle of medium length; ears are typically erect or semi-erect and set well.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown, bright, alert, and expressive; almond-shaped.
attributes.coat: Dense, harsh, wiry double coat texture. Colors are typically ranges of tan, reddish-brown, or grizzle, often with black tipping.
attributes.body: Compact, sturdy, and well-muscled build. Tail is typically carried level with the back or slightly elevated, often covered in the same wiry coat.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the compact, agile body structure and the characteristic harsh, dense wiry coat texture.

attributes.head_and_ears: Small, refined skull; tapering muzzle; ears carried erect and close to the head.
attributes.eyes: Dark, bright, almond-shaped eyes conveying alertness.
attributes.coat: Fine, silky double coat; texture is smooth and dense. Coloration typically ranges from rich tan/gold on the body to steel blue or black on the head and legs.
attributes.body: Small, delicate frame; proportionate to the head. Tail is carried high and plume-like.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the small, elegant structure and the characteristic bi-colored/multi-toned coat pattern (tan body transitioning to blue/black head and legs).
